checks.acceptance: One stored clip is decodable, has audio, and duration within registered tolerance; no extra scored time.
checks.stimulus: Start at server-pinned time and run to ten-minute boundary.

checks.acceptance: Each failure has an explicit recovery disposition and no silent scored artifact.
checks.stimulus: Deny permission, background the tab, close it, and switch mobile camera mode.

checks.acceptance: Live preview, local test playback and stored clip show the same processed stream with no raw-frame fallback.

claim_ceiling: Candidate design record only; no executed check, selected integration, participant-data permission or release.
evidence_requirements: attributed pass, fail or inconclusive result for every check
logs or receipts sufficient for independent replay
recorded deviations, adverse effects and unresolved uncertainty
failure_route: Hold capture mode and use technical review or alternate response mode; retain failed evidence.
objective: Prove visible, timed, decodable capture across supported modes.
rejection_gates: any silent data loss or untraceable score-path change
unresolved differential failure or unsupported mode presented as valid
threshold_registration: Quantitative limits, supported devices, cost ceiling and reviewer acceptance authority must be fixed before a run can support pilot selection.
